name: Shenyang Shengjing Department Store Management (Group) Co., Ltd. (沈阳盛京百货管理（集团）有限公司)
via: a subsidiary of Shenyang Shengjing Assets Management Group Co., Ltd. (the Shenyang SASAC published the group's recruitment as its subsidiary, 2026-06-08); it operates the Shengjing Department Store (盛京百货) stores
note: Shenyang department-store retailer; per Tencent News (2026-03-17), 盛京百货 is the renamed former Shenyang No. 2 Department Store ('沈阳第二百货商店'), a Shenyang store with a 70-plus-year history. The department-store group's party secretary and chairman Jiang Yanbo described the Liaoning Tieren deal as Shengjing Assets Group implementing the city government's guidance (club's official signing report, Dongqiudi/Tencent News, 2026-01-11). Front-of-shirt sponsor of Liaoning Tieren for the 2026 CSL season.
